incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - High error rate detected for service "inference-proxy" in us-west-2. 5m error rate = 12% (baseline 0.3%). PagerDuty incident created: PD-9876.

PagerDuty: Paging oncall: Jamal (SRE) - Incident PD-9876 - acknowledge with /ack

Alex R.: I'm on this. Paging primary oncall now. Jamal, you good to take if you get the page?

Jamal (SRE): Acked. I'm taking incident. Joining war room: https://meet.redwood.com/rooms/pd-9876 

Maria K.: Thanks Jamal. Can you confirm impact on customers? Any in-flight requests failing or just retries?

Jamal (SRE): Early look: proxy 502s for a subset of requests to model-host pool. Logs show upstream timeouts to model-host pool. Running quick check:
```bash
# check recent 502s
kubectl logs svc/inference-proxy --since=10m | grep "502" | wc -l
```
Seeing ~480 errors in last 5m. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream.

Sophia: Which customers are affected? Any enterprise tenants on Dedicated or Private?

Jamal (SRE): Looks like hosted API customers only. No Dedicated clusters. Top affected tenants: acme-inc (high rate), zebra-analytics. Running per-tenant query now.

Alex R.: Assigning incident owner for external comms: Maria, can you do status page + email if confirmed? I'll handle rollback/fallback routing.

Maria K.: I can do status page. Draft below, please +1 or edit:
"Impact: Hosted inference API experiencing increased errors for text generation endpoints in us-west-2. Scope: subset of requests, some customers seeing 5xx errors and timeouts. Mitigation: routing fallback to us-east is being applied for affected traffic. Next update in 15 minutes."

Sophia: +1, add "Customer action: retry with default region or contact support" and link to workaround docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/region-fallback

Jamal (SRE): Working mitigation: forcing model routing to fallback variant and increasing model-host pool. Commands run:
```yaml
# routing override
kubectl apply -f override-fallback-us-west.yaml
# scale model hosts
kubectl scale deploy model-host --replicas=12 -n inference
```
Initial error rate dropping to 6% in last 2m.

Alex R.: Good. Maria, please post to status page with "Identified; mitigation in progress". Also notify top 5 impacted customers via support template below.

Maria K.: Using template:
Subject: Temporary degradation: Hosted inference (us-west-2)
Body:
"Hello — we're seeing elevated error rates on hosted inference in us-west-2 impacting text generation endpoints. Our on-call has applied routing fallback and is scaling hosts. We're monitoring; next update ~15 minutes. Ticket: PD-9876. If you see continued failures please reply to this thread or open a support ticket."
Sending to acme-inc & zebra-analytics now. :mailbox_with_mail: 

Ops Oncall (pager): Handoff note for next shift: jamal -> alex. Please include runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/inference-errors

Jamal (SRE): Leaving a short blameless note: root cause suspect: recently deployed autoscaler config change for model-host pool. Investigating. Handing to Alex for follow-through on config revert if needed. Handoff at 2112345740.

Alex R.: I'll take postmortem owner. Will coordinate rollback with infra. Keep me in loop.

incident-bot: Update: Error rate decreased to 2.1% over last 5m. Monitoring continues. Next planned update 2112345800.

Maria K.: Posted status page: https://status.redwood.example.com/incidents/pd-9876 - ping me if you need copy edits.

Sophia: Thanks everyone. Quick note — prepare customer-facing follow-up explaining root cause and steps once stabilized.
